item.title: Philips unveils world’s first 1000 Hz gaming monitor
item.description: Philips’ Evnia 27M2N5500XD is the world’s first 1000 Hz gaming screen Philips has just unveiled its fastest monitor to date, the Evnia 27M2N5500XD. The company claims that this is the world’s first 1000 Hz gaming monitor. Using dual-mode technology, this screen offers 1000 Hz HD mode and 500 Hz QHD (1440p) mode.
